title: Candidate result (counted votes for one candidate in one contest)
description: PROPOSAL, not implemented. 'Leader' is a numeric fact about the count and is separate from a call and from certification.

candidate_key.description: FEC candidate ID or TIP placeholder ID (for example GOV-PA-SHAPIRO), matching data/elections/<ST>/candidates.json; or a validated independent key with mapping_note.

display_name.description: Name as printed by the source.

percent_method.description: vote_percent requires 'source' or 'computed_from_total'; computed values use a validated race total.

is_leader.description: Highest counted votes at this capture. Not a call.
